dexterity_modifier.rule: Apply DEX modifier to proficiency throws for: open_locks, pick_pockets, find_traps, remove_traps, hide_in_shadows, move_silently, climb_walls.
DEX modifier does not apply to hijinks.

thief_skill_modifiers.encumbrance: <rule condition="encumbrance <= 5_stone">+2 bonus to climb_walls, hide_in_shadows, move_silently. <rule condition="encumbrance <= 2_stone">+4 bonus to climb_walls, hide_in_shadows, move_silently. Encumbrance bonuses do not apply to hijinks.

skill.name: open_locks
skill.rule: Requires 1 turn and a successful proficiency throw.
May attempt in 1 round at -10 penalty (-4 with Lockpicking proficiency).
Thieves' tools break and become unusable.

revised_thief_skills.skill:
Requires 1 turn per 10 square feet and a successful proficiency throw. May attempt in 1 round at -10 penalty (-4 with Trap Finding proficiency). Retries allowed. <rule condition="failure_by <= 4">Detects presence of trap (if present) but not details.
Trap triggered. Believes trap exists but lacks details.

skill.name: remove_traps
skill.rule: May only remove traps that are found (not merely suspected).
Requires 1 turn and a successful proficiency throw.
May attempt in 1 round at -10 penalty.

hideouts_and_syndicates.rules: Hideouts are secret strongholds; do not secure domains or attract families. Gain 2d6 level 1 followers (same class); must be paid. Additional ruffians may be hired. <rule condition="level <= 8">No automatic followers until level 9. Hideouts must be within 6 miles of an urban settlement.

general.rule: Total time ~1 month including planning, execution, and laying low.

assignment.rule: Assigning hijinks to all members at base = 1 major activity.
Normally 1 hijink per member per month.

planning.rule: Required for: arson, assassinating, escaping, infiltrating, kidnapping, sabotaging, smuggling, stealing.

laying_low.rule: Required after: arson, assassinating, escaping, infiltrating, sabotaging, smuggling, subverting, stealing.
Cannot perform hijinks in same base during this time.
Caught on next hijink if failure_by ≥11 OR natural 1-3.

rules.rule: Multiple perpetrators may act as a crew.
Max crew = honcho henchmen slots; excess members impose -1 each.
Effective level = sum of successful members’ levels.
Failing members caught; successful may escape.
Rewards split pro rata among uncaught members.

hasty_hijinks.rule: Second roll required to determine capture.

procedure.step: Roll 2d6 on Crime and Punishment table.
Apply modifiers: CHA, proficiencies, attorney, bribery, evidence, interpleader, prior crimes, severity.

rules.rule: Boss expected to cover legal costs.

awaiting_trial.rule: May plead guilty to receive lesser punishment.

management.rule: Underboss controls 20% of subordinates for assignment purposes.

rules.rule: Boss gains XP from net monthly hijink income exceeding threshold.
Members gain XP equal to 50% of hijink value.
0-level characters can advance via hijinks (typically carousing).
Crew XP split pro rata among uncaught members.

confidence_notes.note: Trial delay table grouped categories inferred due to formatting ambiguity.
Some hijink-specific numeric rewards generalized where redundant table data overlapped.
